name: FTPP (Adipotide)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: FTPP (Adipotide) is a cyclic synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 5 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is FTPP (Adipotide) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: FTPP (Adipotide) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the FTPP certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 859216-15-2, formula C111H206N36O28S2, 2557.2 Da).

faq.question: How should FTPP (Adipotide) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for FTPP (Adipotide): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the FTPP lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for FTPP (Adipotide)?
faq.answer: FTPP (Adipotide) is stocked in 1 pack size (5 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $125.34; 10–49 kits falls to $115.32 (−8%) and 50+ to $106.54 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
